facts.title: Refusing the Idols
facts.text: At Eriza, Gregory refuses to sacrifice to Anahit and endures twelve tortures inflicted by King Tiridates III.

facts.title: The Dark Dungeon
facts.text: Cast into a pit infested with scorpions and snakes, he miraculously survives thanks to a widow's bread.

facts.title: The King Delivered
facts.text: Guided by a vision of Princess Khosrovidukht, Oda Amatuni frees Gregory, who cures the sovereign.
Grateful, Tiridates III embraces the faith of Christ and makes Armenia the first Christian state in the world.
Following a vision of Christ striking the earth with a golden hammer, Gregory consecrates Etchmiadzin Cathedral.

facts.title: The Holy Right Hand
facts.text: The holy relic of the confessor's right arm is used for the blessing of the holy chrism every seven years.

facts.title: The Lusavorich
facts.text: Having become the first Catholicos of All Armenians, Saint Gregory remains the nation's immortal guide.

ytTitle: Gregory the Illuminator, the Apostle Who Led Armenia to Baptism in 301
ytLead: Cast into the pit of Khor Virap then freed to heal King Tiridates III, Saint Gregory is the founding father of the Armenian Church. In 301, his actions made Armenia the first nation to officially embrace Christianity.
